full_judgment: 16. Furthermore it is settled principle of law that no one shall be condemned unheard (audi alterem partem). Having considered the stated fact it is appearant that in the instant case, the concerned respondent in violation of the provision of section 9 of the "বাংলাদেশ ট্রাভেল এজেন্সি" (নিবন্ধন ও নিয়ন্ত্রন) সংশোধন আইন, ২০১৩ as well as principle of natural justice issued the impugned order.
